events.event: Anthropic shares fell below the US$83 IPO price in pre-market trading on 24 November, about 25% below the 19 November opening price, amid valuation worries, a tech sell-off and insider sales.
events.key_numbers: IPO price US$83 · 19 Nov open US$111.50 · 24 Nov US$83.39 (-5%) · Dario and Daniela Amodei each sold over 3.37 million shares worth over US$280 million · gross IPO proceeds record US$93.5 billion · MSCI adds Anthropic at close of 30 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Shows how fast hyped AI IPOs can turn for retail investors, with MSCI inclusion on 30 Nov as the next catalyst.

events.event: Telkom, Kemenko Polkam and seven other bodies signed a collaboration declaration on post-quantum cryptography, with BSSN forming a national PQC migration task force.
events.key_numbers: 9 parties signed · 3 working groups (Technical, Policy, Industry and Talent) · NIST first PQC standards Aug 2024 · no Indonesian target date given
events.why_it_matters: Future quantum computers could break today's encryption protecting banking and government data, so migration has to start now.

events.event: Google will shut the Nest app on 25 January 2027 and retire Google Assistant on Home devices on 2 August 2027, replacing them with Google Home and Gemini.
events.key_numbers: Nest app closes 25 Jan 2027 · Google Assistant retired 2 Aug 2027 · Nest Aware becomes Google Home Premium
events.why_it_matters: Owners of Nest cameras and Google speakers must move to Google Home, and subscriptions are renamed.

events.event: Komdigi is preparing a ministerial regulation with a tariff formula guideline for two-wheeler food and goods delivery by ojol platforms, aiming to issue it before 31 December 2026.
